# MxPage

> Open-source, locally deployable AI e-commerce image workspace by Lingju Huijing (灵矩绘境 / MatrixInspire). MIT source license. Current documentation: v0.3.0, 2026-10-17.

## Product facts

- Canonical repository: https://github.com/ziguishian/MxPage
- Chinese keywords: AI 电商详情页、商品主图、详情页长图、批量图片翻译、小红书图文、本地部署。
- Inputs: reference photos, supplied facts, platform, language, counts and confirmed supplemental answers.
- Outputs: hero/detail images, per-image edits, version history, ZIP and stitched detail-page images.
- Detail task counts: 3–10 HERO and 4–20 DETAIL. Platform presets do not publish to marketplaces.
- V4: deterministic state machine with individual OpenAI SDK structured JSON requests. No @openai/agents dependency, Runner or tool loop.
- Detail models: provider-discovered GPT-6 Luna and GPT Image 2.5 Flare IDs; no automatic substitution of dated variants. User-supplied provider/key required.
- Stages: PREPARE, PLAN, WAITING_INPUT, ART_DIRECTION, GENERATE, IMAGE_REVIEW, SET_REVIEW, COMPLETED/PARTIAL/FAILED.
- First HERO precedes the remaining images; concurrency capped at two. Checkpoints reuse completed output; heartbeat leases guard writes.
- Possibly billed uncertain requests are not automatically retried. Stop drains issued requests without dispatching new ones. Explicit retry authorization is scoped to relevant requests.
- Supplemental dialogs offer concrete inferred options plus custom input. Selected simulated values retain provenance and must not be claimed as measured/certified.
- Local canonical text wrapping preserves known specifications, units and table cells while tolerating natural rephrasing.
- Review issues retain images without automatic regeneration. Sets over 12 images use overlapping review groups.
- Independent fixed-prompt batch image translation has no analysis/planning Agent calls.
- Shared queue, stage/per-image timings, cost/stability charts, local profile and rolling 12-month usage heatmap.
- CNY cost display uses editable rates/conversion; distinguishes returned amounts, estimates and unpriced requests. Not a final provider bill.
- Distribution: Windows x64 ZIP, macOS Apple Silicon ZIP, macOS Intel ZIP and self-hosted source. Native CI smoke-tests SQLite/Prisma/sharp and local routes, without paid model calls.
- Desktop requires no separate Node installation; user data stays in OS user-data folders. No commercial signing/Apple notarization; macOS uses ad-hoc signing.
- Development: Node.js 24, npm ci, Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Prisma/SQLite, Electron. Desktop builds must not overwrite live .next output.
- Keys remain in browser/request context, not project records. Inference data goes to the configured model provider; local hosting is not offline generation.
- Old workflow versions remain read-only history/export, without migration into V4. Verify output claims, appearance, parameters and translations.

Current screenshots were captured on 2026-10-17 from v0.3.0. The curated gallery contains six real sets with source photos, hero images, detail panels and full stitched pages. Latest candle/burner/diffuser requests used auto quality; earlier tea/mug studies used low. All use recorded gpt-6-luna / gpt-image-2.5-flare IDs. PARTIAL review status and selected-estimate provenance are documented; examples are not guarantees or measured product specifications. Database files, credentials and request logs are not part of the gallery.

This is the editable index. scripts/sync-public-docs.cjs copies it to public/llms.txt. Older design notes and root-level v0.2.0 screenshots are historical. Public homepage indexing is opt-in via NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL; private workspace routes are excluded from sitemap/indexing.
